guidance: Read plan/get and choose from actions for the stable step IDs. Start before work. After verifying actual results, prefer complete with a nonempty reason citing observed completion evidence. Complete atomically handles started and unstarted leaves together without inventing starts or execution time. Finish remains strict and requires recorded starts; reconcile accepts only unstarted leaves. Pause for a checkpoint and start before handling its result. Never fabricate bookkeeping start/finish. Block only for an actual obstacle. These actions preserve the entire tree and real timing rules.

guidance: Read plan/get first. Send complete flat nodes without status. Existing execution states are preserved and new nodes are pending. Use plan/action for execution, not structure edits. Revision, identity and started-leaf constraints still apply.

estimate.description: Optional total processing-time range for the agreed execution plan, excluding user waits. Submit only after the execution agreement is resolved; never estimate from skill selection. The host displays it only after a step starts. Omit to preserve on update; null clears it. Create and revise without an estimate clear it. On revise provide a new total for the whole plan including work already performed, not remaining time.

guidance: First call plan/get with request={} for the current turn_id, plan and revision. Call plan/write: outer operation is always write; request.operation is create, update, revise or release, not action. Create a new plan_id with expected_revision=0 only when no structured plan exists. Otherwise reuse plan_id and the current revision. Send complete flat items with stable ids and optional parent_id; Keep ids unchanged when renaming steps. Start each leaf with in_progress before performing its work; never batch pending leaves directly to completed. Parents aggregate child execution time, and parallel leaves may be in_progress together. Declare a container as kind=group before starting it; its children may be refined later. Groups only aggregate children and cannot complete without children. Refine an ordinary leaf before starting it, not after. No children field is supported. Use a new request_id per mutation, reusing it only for an identical retry, and the current turn_id. Update changes progress without changing root content or existing parent links. Revise changes structure and requires a non-empty reason. For normal completion, use update to mark finished items completed. Release opts out of structured planning, requires a non-empty reason and preserves items; it is not ordinary completion. On revision conflict, reread plan/get before a changed retry.
